'''Warren William Brandt ''' (July 11, 1923 – July 4, 2017) was an American academic. He was the first [[List of presidents of Virginia Commonwealth University|president]] of [[Virginia Commonwealth University]], serving from 1969 to 1974,<ref>{{cite web|title=Warren W. Brandt, first president of VCU, dies at 93|work=[[Richmond Times-Dispatch]]|date=July 7, 2017|url=https://richmond.com/news/obituary/warren-w-brandt-first-president-of-vcu-dies-at-93/article_217eacb1-99d0-5b32-b01a-6d871a43bd0b.html|accessdate=September 4, 2022}}</ref> and the eleventh president of [[Southern Illinois University Carbondale]], from 1974 to 1979.
